metadata.question: Does the land covered by lava flows increase in the Todoque and El Paraíso areas of La Palma between May 21, 2021 and December 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting changes in lava flow coverage in La Palma between May 21, 2021 and December 15, 2021. This was during the 2021 Cumbre Vieja volcanic eruption. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for high-resolution monitoring 2. Focus on the Todoque and El Paraíso areas in La Palma 3. Use NIR/SWIR bands to detect lava flows (lava has distinct spectral signature) 4. Compare two time periods: pre-eruption (May 2021) and post-eruption (December 2021) 5. Count lava pixels in each period to detect increase Approach: - Define polygon around Todoque and El Paraíso areas - Use Sentinel-2 Level-2A (surface reflectance) - Compute NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) or use SWIR bands to detect lava - Threshold to identify lava pixels - Compare pixel counts between the two dates Data quality considerations: - May 2021 should show little/no lava (pre-eruption) - December 2021 should show significant lava flows (post-eruption) - Cloud masking is crucial - If no images available, try fallback strategies ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laPalma = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-17.95, 28.55], [-17.75, 28.55], [-17.75, 28.70], [-17.95, 28.70], [-17.95, 28.55]] ]); const may2021 = ee.DateRange('2021-05-01', '2021-05-31'); const dec2021 = ee.DateRange('2021-12-01', '2021-12-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance function getLavaMask(img) { // Use SWIR and NIR bands to detect lava (lava has low reflectance in SWIR) const swir1 = img.select('B11'); const swir2 = img.select('B12'); const nir = img.select('B8'); // Lava typically has SWIR1 > 0.3 and NIR/SWIR ratio < 1.5 const lavaMask = swir1.gt(0.3).and(nir.divide(swir1).lt(1.5)); return lavaMask; } function getCloudMask(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return mask; } // Get May 2021 collection (pre-eruption baseline) let mayCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(laPalma) .filterDate(may2021) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(function(img) { return img.updateMask(getCloudMask(img)); }); // Get December 2021 collection (post-eruption) let decCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(laPalma) .filterDate(dec2021) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(function(img) { return img.updateMask(getCloudMask(img)); }); // Check collection sizes const maySize = mayCol.size().getInfo(); const decSize = decCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 2021 Images: ${maySize}, December 2021 Images: ${decSize}`); if (maySize === 0 || decSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create composites and lava masks const mayComposite = mayCol.median(); const decComposite = decCol.median(); const mayLava = getLavaMask(mayComposite); const decLava = getLavaMask(decComposite); // Count lava pixels const mayStats = mayLava.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: laPalma, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const decStats = decLava.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: laPalma, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mayCount = mayStats.get('B11').getInfo(); const decCount = decStats.get('B11').getInfo(); console.log(`May 2021 lava pixels: ${mayCount}`); console.log(`December 2021 lava pixels: ${decCount}`); // Check for valid pixels if (mayCount === null || decCount === null) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (mayCount === 0 && decCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Determine if lava increased const increaseRatio = decCount / Math.max(mayCount, 1); console.log(`Lava increase ratio: ${increaseRatio.toFixed(2)}`); if (decCount > mayCount * 1.5) { // 50% increase threshold console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
